candidate: Colt DCS Navi Mumbai Campus (Mumbai 1, Mumbai 2 and Mumbai 3), Trans Thane Creek Industrial Area, Navi Mumbai: MIDC plot-centroid campus locator (new site, Mumbai 3 project)

source.service: MIDC CitizenPortal/MIDC_Main_Map_Service MapServer layer 11 'Plot Boundary' (gis.midcindia.org), query IA_CODE=201 AND PLOT_NUMBER='KALWA-K-5/05A', fields limited to plot identifiers, area, published centroid, allotment status, land use and the general remark (no user or editor fields requested)
source.statement: One feature: OBJECTID 271854, IA_NAME 'Trans Thane Creek Industrial Area', IA_CODE 201, PLOT_NUMBER 'KALWA-K-5/05A', MIDC_PLOT_AREA 62490.0, LONGITUDE 73.00080212 and LATITUDE 19.17329885 (field aliases 'Longitude (X Coordinate of Plot Centroid)' and 'Latitude (Y Coordinate of Plot Centroid)'), ALLOTED_STATUS_TYPE 2 (ALLOTED), MIDC_LAND_USE 1 (Industrial), REMARK 'Combine Area Given Of Plot No 5 & 5A.', one ring of 52 vertices in EPSG:32643.

native_ring.crs: EPSG:32643 WGS 84 / UTM zone 43N (response spatialReference wkid 32643)

transformation.operation: Inverse of UTM zone 43N on WGS 84 (no datum change), used only to check the published centroid and the operator coordinate

selected_point_basis: The plot centroid MIDC publishes in the record's LONGITUDE and LATITUDE fields, retained unchanged (direct geometry), as for the published Sify Airoli KALWA-K-10 locator in the same industrial area.

checks.operator_coordinate: Colt DCS's own location records for 'Mumbai 3' and 'Mumbai 1 & 2' (Sitecore page data in colt-mumbai-3.html, sha256 ed4f09601f4e4bbb8e0f4f62c4ae540c404ffeee959f30007d4f88a34e0b4af2, and colt-mumbai-1-2.html, sha256 e24fb4f57f07554465da40d80fba082f40fcd15e85f74a2735fe77b6e7ae60bd) both carry Latitude 19.17318 and Longitude 73.00102 for the location (a separate LocationCity record for the city of Mumbai carries 19.07283, 72.88261 and is a city reference, not used). The operator coordinate lies inside the KALWA-K-5/05A ring, 74.8 m from its edge and 26.4 m from the selected centroid; the operator's city reference lies 16.7 km away and is not used.
checks.operator_area_match: Colt DCS's Mumbai Data Centre Construction Timeline page (colt-mumbai-timeline.html, sha256 6915f65fed628ac8a4080f7f6867081c84a5e1e1a33c3f6dabed322d0b90c690) gives the site overview '134MW', 'Gross Floor Area 62,490 m2', '100% connectivity neutral' and 'PUE 1.45'. The figure 62,490 m2 is exactly MIDC_PLOT_AREA of KALWA-K-5/05A; Colt's 14 September 2023 launch release (colt-mumbai-launch-2023.html, sha256 a81ecb1b0268427a7c9a6074f36e90fbb10e9ccfa51290fde66bee0b6f811b24) describes the Navi Mumbai data centre's 'land parcel of 15 acres' (about 60,700 m2). The match is used as identity evidence; Colt's 'gross floor area' label is not adopted as a building measurement.
checks.uniqueness: Query IA_CODE=201 AND PLOT_NUMBER LIKE '%K-5%' (midc-ttc-plot-k5-search.json, sha256 8bc24b6df2b9120822529dc56e6e96295f409fd927b67ad017431a649a370704) returns 15 Trans Thane Creek plots; KALWA-K-5/05A (62,490 m2) is the only large industrial plot numbered 5 or 5A; the others are K-50 to K-59 plots or small amenity 'PAP' plots of 100-300 m2.
checks.neighbouring_plots: A 300 m buffer query around the selected centroid (midc-plots-near-kalwa-k-5-05a.json, sha256 cfd3ac28ee8cb314bbaf726c504e2a9f8da18d3476feda6e26c698b185d61a90) lists KALWA-K-5/05A, the neighbouring industrial plots KALWA-K-6 (35,310 m2), KALWA-K-11, K-12, K-14/1, K-14/2+K-15+K-37 (26,614 m2), K-34 and K-35, small amenity and utility parcels, and encroachment parcels. None is attributed to Colt DCS by any source used.
checks.atlas_records_within_2km: Checked on 7 November 2026 against verified_construction_core/2026-11-07-research-hundredtwentysixth (986 sites, 1,061 projects, 5,812 evidence rows; sites.csv, projects.csv, evidence.csv, source-records.json, identity-mapping.json), every pending queue changes.json, claims.tsv and all holds. Distances from the selected point: CapitaLand DC Navi Mumbai Campus (CapitaLand Mumbai 01, another operator; Tower 1 and Tower 2) at 282.5 m, whose point lies 191.8 m outside the KALWA-K-5/05A ring (a point-in-polygon test against the plots over 15,000 m2 returned by an envelope query, midc-large-plots-digha-envelope.json, sha256 2dbfa8d0c8ea6d7e81de11a152612f47cc5dd1a2741e2dedaa4845b4a3dd4817, places it in the MIDC plot listed as KALWA-K-14/2, KALWA-K-15, KALWA-K-37, 26,614 m2); Sify Airoli Data Center (MUM02, MIDC plot KALWA-K-10) at 438.7 m; Digital Edge Navi Mumbai Campus (BOM1-BOM3, PARIVESH ring centroid) at 1,436.4 m. The next nearest Atlas site is Sify Rabale (3.1 km). No Atlas, queued or claimed record names Colt DCS in India, RMZ, plot K-5/5A or the Colt Navi Mumbai campus.

limitations: MIDC states no positional accuracy for its plot layer. The point stands for a 6.2 ha plot that, according to Colt DCS, holds the operating Mumbai 1 and Mumbai 2 data centres, the Mumbai 3 build and a 220 kV GIS substation; the Mumbai 3 building is not separately located. No map service, embedded map, map link, PeeringDB or OpenStreetMap data, imagery, city centre, head-office address or industrial-area centroid is used.
